# portainer_edge_stack (Data Source)

The `portainer_edge_stack` data source allows you to look up an existing Portainer Edge stack by its name.

## Example Usage

### Look up an Edge stack by name

```hcl
data "portainer_edge_stack" "monitoring" {
  name = "edge-monitoring"
}

output "edge_stack_id" {
  value = data.portainer_edge_stack.monitoring.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the edge stack to look up in Portainer.

### Read-Only

- `deployment_type` (Number) Deployment type of the edge stack (0 = Compose, 1 = Kubernetes, 2 = Nomad).
- `id` (String) Identifier of the edge stack.
